description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Cooperate from your graveyard by paying {2}{U}, targeting the spell.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Cooperate, with the copy targeting the original Cooperate.
Resolve the copy of Cooperate, copying Cooperate, targeting the original Cooperate.
Repeat step 4.
